title: Shared Model Space Across Play Windows
description: CAD spatial play quad: all renderer windows must keep showing their model-definition view when another window is focused or receives play interaction; one shared ModelSpace with per-pane viewport binding.
summary: Fixed quad play windows dropping geometry when another pane was focused. Root cause: the shape viewport used the provider's active documentModel and activeModelDefinitionId, so focusing building/energy/structure switched the shape canvas to that definition (often with no committed meshes). Each pane now binds to its own row in flushedModelsByDefinitionId via spatialPlayPaneModel; shape PlaySession always edits spatial.shape through commitModelForDefinition. focusModelDefinition only updates chrome focus (flush + active id) without bumping modelDefinitionRevision, and history/snapshot reset is tied to interaction/asset changes instead of every revision bump. All 43 cad/js/renderer vitest tests pass.
